title: Binance CFO Departs Following Major Crypto Hack
excerpt: The chief financial officer of Binance has announced their departure to pursue a new venture, shortly after a massive security breach.
body_html:
The chief financial officer of Binance is stepping down from the company to pursue a new venture.

This departure announcement follows shortly after a major security incident where hackers stole cryptocurrency worth $6.3 billion from users of the platform.

The exit comes just over a week after the massive digital asset theft occurred, marking a significant leadership change for the cryptocurrency exchange during a turbulent period.
